abstract: OBJECTIVE: To review the outcome of treatment in patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and to define the risk factors for recurrence. MATERIAL AND METHODS: Forty-one patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors were reviewed retrospectively. Survival time and survival rate were obtained. Risk factors such as stage, histological type, and type of operation were evaluated for reccurrence. RESULTS: Twenty-three (56%) had dysgerminomas, eight (19.5%) had mixed germ cell tumors, three (7.3%) had yolk sac tumors, three (7.3%) had immature teratomas, two (4.8%) had squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature teratoma, one (2.4%) had embryonal carcinoma and one choriocarcinoma. Most of the cases (73%) were in Stage I. Twenty-nine patients (70.7%) underwent conservative surgery and 12 patients (29.3%) had at least bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Thirty patients were operated on optimally with surgical staging and 11 suboptimally. Seven patients (17%) had recurrence after remission. The overall survival time was 187 +/- 8.43 months for all cases, 195 +/- 8.49 for dysgerminoma and 161 +/- 10.96 for non-dysgerminoma cases with a median follow-up time of 98.52 (8-204) months. Non-dysgerminoma histologic type, being operated on suboptimally and radically, and advanced tumor stage have been found to be risk factors for recurrence. CONCLUSION: Regardless of histologic types and stages the prognosis of germ cell tumors are satisfactory with current therapeutic strategies.
abstract_ja: 目的：卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者の治療成績を検討し、再発の危険因子を明らかにすること。対象と方法：卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の患者41例を後方視的に検討した。生存期間および生存率を算出した。病期、組織型、手術方法などの因子について再発との関連を評価した。結果：23例（56%）がディスジャーミノーマ、8例（19.5%）が混合型胚細胞腫瘍、3例（7.3%）が卵黄嚢腫瘍、3例（7.3%）が未熟奇形腫、成熟奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌が2例（4.8%）、胎児性癌が1例、絨毛癌が1例であった。大部分（73%）は病期Iであった。29例（70.7%）が温存手術を受け、12例（29.3%）は少なくとも両側付属器切除術を受けた。30例は手術による病期分類を伴う最適手術を受け、11例は不完全手術であった。7例（17%）が寛解後に再発した。全症例の全生存期間は187±8.43か月、ディスジャーミノーマ症例は195±8.49か月、非ディスジャーミノーマ症例は161±10.96か月であった（追跡中央値98.52か月、範囲8～204か月）。非ディスジャーミノーマ組織型、不完全手術、根治的手術、進行病期が再発の危険因子であった。結論：組織型や病期によらず、現行の治療戦略により胚細胞腫瘍の予後は概ね良好である。
